procedure: Started observed authoring/validation interval at14:09:07UTC after revised no-Blender specification arrived.
Authored normalized rectangular and revolution SVG paths plus a pure absolute M/L/Z parser.
Extruded/revolved independently specified profiles and assembled the same three stand-in stall variants; original generator is used only in separate validator/comparison modules.

Compared bidirectional unique-vertex distances, triangle counts, palette slots and semantic boundary edge sets.
Exported BufferGeometry JSON and checked all four attributes and kit unit after reload.
Captured both routes at native64px with the same B renderer/camera, compared color pixels and edge masks, and displayed the paired contact sheet.
Ran typecheck, lint, application build and final headed demonstration; all passed. Closed all launched browser processes.
Finished authoring/validation interval at14:21:46UTC; final evidence packaging is outside that interval.

geometry.method: Independently authored SVG M/L/Z profiles extruded or revolved; original generator is imported only by the validation module.
